title: Share gateway quotas across project keys and restrict project creation

endpoints.before: Authenticated legacy gateway requests used independent per-key, per-Cloudflare-location tier counters, separate from v1 and console quotas; approved custom RPM did not govern this limiter. Accounts could create up to ten projects with a non-atomic check.
endpoints.after: All API keys and console sessions in a project share one exact UTC-aligned 60-second global quota across authenticated legacy/v1 gateway traffic, using project tier/custom RPM. Expensive v1 caps are shared per project. Cache hits count; quota exhaustion returns 429 and unavailable admission returns retryable 503 QUOTA_UNAVAILABLE. Legacy responses expose project RateLimit headers. Accounts include one project unless an operator approves more; atomic creation enforces a 24-hour cooldown that survives deletion. Existing projects and keys remain usable.
endpoints.clientAction: Keep existing keys; coordinate request budgets across the project's keys, console and API versions. Respect Retry-After and request a project limit increase if necessary. Contact the egdata team for additional projects; creating or rotating keys no longer adds capacity. See docs/project-quota-rollout.md for migration and existing-grant review.
